name: Polarnode Nokia data center campus
notes: Polarnode and the City of Nokia agreed on a Juhansuo industrial plot; planned first phase is 30 MW on 5.5 hectares, with later expansion potential reported up to 100 MW.

name: FCDC Valkeakoski data center
notes: Aggregator lists FCDC planning a large-scale Valkeakoski facility in Mahlianmaa near Highway 130; FCDC official site confirms it develops ready-to-build data center campuses but does not expose project details on the crawled page.

name: Glesys Tampere data center
notes: Glesys official page markets an operating Tampere data center for colocation/cloud; DCD reported Verne sold its Tampere facility to Glesys in 2025.

name: FCDC Vaasa data center campus
notes: City of Vaasa says the building permit for Kuriiritie 7 was approved on 10 Dec 2025; roughly 66,000 sqm in GigaVaasa/Laajametsä, construction estimated for 2026 and operation in 2028-2029.

name: Microsoft GigaVaasa potential datacenter development
notes: Microsoft and Vaasa announced a preliminary agreement for about 190 hectares in the GigaVaasa area, about two-thirds in Vaasa and one-third in Mustasaari, to support potential datacenter development.

name: YIT Kontiolahti Vellamo data center campus
notes: Kontiolahti municipality and YIT signed planning/reservation cooperation for about 25 hectares in the Vellamo business area in Lehmo, north of Joensuu; detailed capacity not disclosed.

name: Glesys/Trevian Campus Oulu
notes: Glesys announced an agreement with Trevian for an AI-ready modular data center campus in Oulu with long-term expansion potential up to 300 MW.

name: AmpTank Utajärvi hyperscale data center
notes: AmpTank announced a first hyperscale project in Utajärvi with 100 MW immediately available plus backup battery storage; DCD places it in Mustikkakangas industrial area outside Oulu.

name: Liminka Kivimäki data center and solar parks
notes: Trade press reported a 30-hectare data center planned with two solar parks at Kivimäki farm in Liminka, near Oulu; capacity details were not disclosed.

name: YIT Kuopio Hepomäki data center project
notes: YIT proposed reserving about 45 hectares in Hepomäki, Kuopio for a new data center; Kuopio plan report states the city board approved the YIT area reservation agreement on 19 Nov 2025.

name: Polarnode Kuopio Mustakorpi data center
notes: Polarnode says the Mustakorpi project between Hiltulanlahti and Pellesmäki would start at about 50 MW and the grid could enable campus expansion up to 250 MW; goal is construction-ready status during 2027.

name: Helios Iisalmi Tervamäki data center
notes: City of Iisalmi announced Helios had started planning a data center in the Tervamäki area and submitted a zoning initiative; Yle reported more than 100 hectares reserved.

name: DayOne Lahti hyperscale data center
notes: Lahti city announced a EUR 1.2bn DayOne data center in Kiveriö; SRV later announced construction start and 2027 operations. DayOne/trade sources state 128 MW total potential with an initial 50 MW building.

name: Polarnode Heinola Vierumäki data center
notes: Polarnode says it is preparing an approximately 40 MW data center on an 11-hectare industrial plot in northern Vierumäki Business Park, aiming for construction readiness in early 2026.

name: FCDC Lahti data center
notes: DCD reported FCDC acquired a 10-hectare Lahti plot from city premises company Spatium for EUR 6m, with plans for a 100 MW facility; aggregator places it at Ilmarisentie 3.

name: ASP DC Pori campus / Ecogrid Energy Park
notes: Business Pori reported ASP DC agreed to acquire a 37-hectare Pori project from CompassForge with 300-400 MW modular capacity; construction set for 2026 and first commercial operation in early 2027.

name: Polarnode Pori Honkaluoto data center project
notes: City/Business Pori described a 26-hectare Honkaluoto project over 100 MW; Polarnode later announced an agreement to sell the shovel-ready, grid-ready project to an undisclosed European operator.

name: Glesys Pori data center
notes: Glesys official page markets its operational Pori facility; DCD reported Verne sold Finnish operations including Pori to Glesys in October 2025.

name: Microsoft Southern Finland datacenter region - Espoo/Kirkkonummi/Vihti
notes: Microsoft says it is building datacenters in southern Finland; 2022 announcement and Fortum materials identify Espoo, Kirkkonummi and Vihti, with Espoo/Kirkkonummi waste heat tied to district heating.

name: Verne Mäntsälä data center campus
notes: Verne marked construction start for the first 70 MW of its Mäntsälä Kapuli-area campus, an approximately 10-hectare AI/HPC-oriented site using renewable energy and planned waste heat reuse.

name: Nebius Mäntsälä AI data center expansion
notes: Nebius announced in 2024 it would triple its Mäntsälä data center to 75 MW; in 2026 Nebius said the Mäntsälä expansion up to 75 MW had been completed earlier in the year.

name: DayOne Nurmijärvi data center project
notes: DayOne announced early-stage plans in Nurmijärvi, subject to approvals and permits, with tentative phased development potential up to 560 MW total grid power.

name: Equinix Helsinki data centers
notes: Equinix official Finland pages state it operates five Finland data centers in Helsinki, offering about 7,750 sqm of colocation space across the market.

name: Telia Helsinki Data Center
notes: Telia official page describes the Helsinki data center colocation facility; DCD reported the Valimotie 5 facility opened in 2018 and could eventually scale toward 100 MW IT load. DataCenterMap lists 24 MW; capacity grade treated as aggregate-derived.

name: Elisa Raisio (Turku) data center
notes: Aggregators list an operational Elisa facility serving the Turku/Raisio market; no primary project page or capacity detail found during this pass.
